name: Tana
summary: Agentic meeting platform where AI agents capture calls and complete follow-up work.
description: Tana is now an agentic meeting platform: AI agents join native video calls, capture what is said and complete follow-up work such as filing issues, drafting emails and updating tools. The company states this is separate from Tana Outliner, its note-taking product. The Free plan offers meeting memory; Pro costs $30 per user per month, with an early-bird price of $20, and includes 20 times the free AI usage.

howToUse.title: Open Tana
howToUse.description: Open Tana and download the app. Start native video calls so the agents on this agentic meeting platform can join.

howToUse.title: Let the agents finish the work
howToUse.description: The agents capture what is said on the calls and complete the follow-up by filing issues, drafting emails and updating your other tools before you hang up.

howToUse.title: Keep memory apart from Outliner
howToUse.description: The company states that this meeting platform is a separate product from Tana Outliner, the note-taking product. The Free plan offers meeting memory. Pro costs $30 per user each month, the early-bird price is $20, and Pro includes 20 times the free AI usage.
